name: theme-cov-hedge-v1-attempt2
description: P9 cell P9-H (lane AL-COMB, task-AL-COMB-report.md; plan DEC-15; registration scripts/specs/p9/rules/theme-cov-hedge-v1.json, every constant fixed blind before any read): composition rule theme-cov-hedge-v1. Hypothesis (Daniel, Mota, Rottke and Santos 2020, RFS 33(5), lit section 1.1 [21]): a characteristic-sorted portfolio carries the priced characteristic and the unpriced covariance of its names with the characteristic's own factor; a hedge leg that holds the characteristic fixed and is short that loading removes the unpriced part (their squared Sharpe 1.31 -> 2.29, 1963/07-2017/06). theme-resid-v1 hedges themes against each other and price-risk-v1 projects beta, vol and size; neither hedges a theme's loading on its own factor. Rule (strategy_ic_theme_hedge.cpp over engine combine/char_cov_hedge.hpp, estimated causally at apply time from the role's own guarded session returns; no fitted constant enters the weights file): per theme t and decision d on the theme's standardised composite R_t (ew-theme-std-v1's re-rank): sleeve s_t(d') = sum_i R_t(d', i) r_i(d' + 2); beta_i = OLS slope of r_i on s_t over the trailing 252 decisions ending d - 2 (>= 126 pairs); beta_perp = beta's residual on [1, R_t(d, .)]; H_t = its centred tied rank; h_t = OLS slope of s_t on the hedge leg's return sum_i H_t r_i, re-estimated every 21 decisions from decision 253 (0 before or below 126 pairs); the theme adds W_t(d) (R_t - h_t H_t) in place of W_t(d) R_t. Before h_t's first estimate the composition is the parent's bit for bit. The change comes only from the atx.research-wave/v2 manifest's rules block [{name: theme-cov-hedge-v1, params: {}}] (Ruling ALCOMB-1; the fitter flag --theme-hedge theme-cov-hedge-v1 is derived from the IC exe's rule table through wave_kinds.COMPOSITION_FLAGS, never from this template); the parent's fit must be --composition ew-theme-std-v1 or --composition ic-shrink-v1, with or without --theme-erc theme-erc-v1, --theme-tsmom theme-tsmom-v1 or --mom-volman mom-volman-v1 (the parents the fitter's --theme-hedge accepts, composition_theme_hedge.PARENT_RULES), and carry no theme-resid-v1 or two-speed-v1 (the fitter and the IC exe refuse both). Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. Gross matching (PM6-6) binds the cell (plan section 5.2): judged at the parent's dollar gross through C2's calibration. Acceptance (PM7-34 default): paired S2 net dSR > 0 against the parent AND mechanics. Predicted before any read (plan section 5.2, OD-3 predictions): book realised vol ratio to the parent < 1; gross alpha ratio about 1. Printed, deciding nothing: the hedge ratios per theme and block (the IC exe's summary.json, each scored role's composition_hedge_trace: the theme names and, per block start 253 + 21 b, h per theme), turnover per unit gross, cost per traded dollar, net Sharpe at 4x NAV. Identity before the cell: the parent's w argv re-run on the new build is byte-identical (no theme_hedge block); ThemeHedgeRule.FlagAbsentIdentity.
